addedCourses: Develops energy-resource/conversion assessment, storage, electricity grids and demand management, with Polysun, experiments and local mini-grid work. Genuine electrical-energy systems study, not a circuit/power-electronics engineering sequence.

Develops product mechanisms, user needs/specifications, concept selection, prototyping and production plans with sustainability and industrial scaling. Genuine design methods; no assumed electronic-system or circuit design assignment.
academicFinding: Linear Systems genuinely develops transforms,filtering,modulation andfeedback; Robotics programs a physical arm andgripper; Energy&Sustainability examines grids/storage/mini-grids; RenewableSystemDesign assesses technical/economic energy options; ConsumerProductDesign provides actual specifications,concepts andprototypes. These are not dismissed as generic context. The full candidate nevertheless organises most learning around mathematical/computational agents,data/algorithm work andenergy appraisal. It does not integrate electrical/semiconductor behaviour,circuit analysis anddevice-level measurements into a sustained progression of electrical-system analysis,design andtesting,which the target learning outcomes andprojects make central. Missing some Delft courses would not itself justify rejection; the absent organising physical-electrical inquiry after strengthening does. No degree-title,licence,exact-equivalence ormatching-course quota is imposed.
